jobs.title: General Manager, Cookin
jobs.description:
About CookUnity:

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About Cookin

Cookin (a CookUnity company) is revolutionizing the food industry by empowering food entrepreneurs to sell their creations online. We democratize access to tools that were previously only available to established restaurants, creating opportunities for culinary talent everywhere.

The Opportunity

We are building Off Menu , the next evolution of Cookin, and are looking for a highly entrepreneurial leader to operate as its GM and founder inside CookUnity.

This is not a traditional product role. It combines general management, product building, teaming with sales, and customer leadership in pursuit of product-market fit. You will own the business journey from an ambiguous problem to a product and business that restaurants adopt, pay for, and continue using.

Working with a small pod of 1-2 engineers, an experienced salesperson, and an operations teammate, you will have the autonomy to build from the ground up with the backing of a late-stage, rapidly growing, and established company.

Key Responsibilities

- Build the business from 0→1: Lead Off Menu from customer discovery and prototype through launch, iteration, and meaningful commercial adoption.

- Own product and go-to-market: Define the target customer, value proposition, positioning, pricing, messaging, distribution, and product roadmap.

- Win the first customers: Work directly with restaurants and our sales person to pitch the product, handle objections, close early partners, and refine the product proposition based on what you learn.

- Own business performance: Drive revenue, GMV, CAC, activation, retention, payback, contribution margin, unit economics, and overall P&L outcomes.

- Build hands-on: Conduct your own research, interrogate data, create prototypes with AI tools, write requirements, and work directly with engineers.

- Manage marketplace dynamics: Balance supply, demand, product experience, operations, and economics across a multi-sided business.

- Create clarity from ambiguity: Establish priorities and move quickly without an existing playbook.

- Lead with visibility: Communicate strategy, progress, risks, and results clearly to senior Cookin leadership.

Required Qualifications

- Demonstrated ownership of taking a product or business from zero to meaningful commercial adoption in a real market.

- Direct experience acquiring first customers of something you helped build.

- Experience owning both product and go-to-market decisions, including customer segmentation, positioning, distribution, and retention.

- Strong commercial fluency across revenue, GMV, CAC, LTV, payback, contribution margin, and unit economics.

- Founder, founding product leader/GM, or high-agency early employee who helped build and scale a business or internal venture without an established playbook.

- Experience building or selling for B2B customers, SMBs, merchants, creators, or independent operators.

- Highly hands-on approach to customer research, data analysis, prototyping, requirements, and execution.

- Practical AI fluency and experience using AI to prototype, analyze data, automate workflows, or accelerate development.

- Strong technical judgment and ability to work directly with engineers.

- Excellent executive communication, high agency, and comfort with ambiguity.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in restaurants, hospitality, food tech, e-commerce, or local commerce

- Experience selling or building for restaurant operators

- Experience with multi-sided marketplaces and merchant acquisition

- Experience launching AI-enabled products

What Sets You Apart

- You think about product and distribution at the same time.

- You have heard "no" from customers, changed the proposition, and gone back out to sell again.

- You can point to concrete commercial outcomes from something you personally built.

- You thrive on tiny teams, limited resources, and problems without a clear owner.

- You want to build a meaningful business, not simply ship a good product.

What We Offer

- The autonomy and breadth of a founder type role with the backing of CookUnity

- Direct visibility and impact at the executive level

- The opportunity to build a new business from the ground up

- A small, fast-moving team where your work will have immediate impact

- A mission-driven environment focused on helping food entrepreneurs thrive

Benefits

🩺 Health Insurance coverage (Canada Life)

⛱  Flexible Paid Time Off

🗓️ 5- year Sabbatical: After 5 years with CookUnity, you get a 4-week paid sabbatical

🐣 Paid Family leave.

🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3-5 days each time the need arises

🥘 A generous amount of CookUnity credits to enjoy our amazing meals, added to your account monthly.

🤖 AI-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster.

🧘🏽‍♀️ Wellness perks: fitness subsidies to build a healthy lifestyle

👩🏾‍🏫 Personalized Spanish coach

🚀 Awesome opportunity to join a company that is looking to change how we eat and how chefs work!

Compensation

All final pay rates will be determined by candidates experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data.
Pay Range for this position
$150,000 — $175,000 CAD

If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you.  Thank you for your time!

CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer . We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.

A quick note for all candidates
We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data)  stay safe while applying to CookUnity.  We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief  “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us:

- Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:  careers.cookunity.com

- Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official  LinkedIn Company Page .

- We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in  @cookunity.com  and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS.

- We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away.

If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

The Role

AI is no longer a roadmap item — it's the operating system for how modern growth teams win. We're hiring a AI Native Engineer, Growth Marketing to be the hands-on builder who embeds AI into every corner of how our Growth team works: performance marketing, creative production, CRM, landing pages, growth ops, and beyond.

This is a rare hybrid role. You're equal parts engineer and growth practitioner — someone who can write a Python script in the morning, ship a Braze-connected AI workflow by afternoon, and explain the business impact to a non-technical stakeholder by EOD. You don't need to have done this at scale before — you need to be obsessed with building at the frontier of what's possible and have the technical chops to make it real.

You'll report directly to the Head of Growth and work across every subteam in the Growth org as their embedded AI engineer.

Responsibilities:

- Performance Marketing: Build AI-powered tools to automate bid strategy analysis, budget pacing alerts, creative performance scoring, and anomaly detection across paid channels (SEM, Meta, Affiliate, YouTube, etc.)

- Creative Studio: Develop AI workflows for ad copy generation, creative brief automation, image asset variation at scale, and creative performance feedback loops between analytics and the studio team

- CRM & Lifecycle: Implement AI-driven personalization and send-time optimization across email, SMS, push, and in-app channels; build agentic workflows that pull Snowflake data, generate segment logic, and trigger Braze campaigns with minimal manual intervention

- Landing Pages & Conversion: Automate LP variant generation, headline testing ideation, and personalization logic by audience segment or traffic source

- Growth Ops: Build internal AI tools — dashboards, Slack bots, report generators — that reduce repetitive analytical work and accelerate decision-making across the team

- Growth Product: Partner with Product and Engineering to identify where AI-powered features (recommendations, dynamic content, smart nudges) can accelerate funnel conversion and retention

- Tooling & Infrastructure: Evaluate, implement, and maintain the AI/ML toolstack that powers Growth — from LLM APIs to workflow orchestration tools to data pipelines

What Success Looks Like

- A measurable reduction in manual hours across mundane Growth through AI-driven automation

- At least 5-10 production-grade AI tools or workflows live and actively used by the team within the first 4 months

- CRM campaigns that are more personalized, faster to launch, and higher-performing because of AI assist

- Creative output volume increases without a proportional increase in headcount

- The Growth team thinks of you first when they want to do something smarter, faster, or at scale

Qualifications:

- 2–5 years of engineering or technical experience, with meaningful hands-on work applying AI/LLMs to real business problems (side projects count — we care about what you've built, not just where)

- Proficiency in Python or Typescript and comfort working with APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar LLM providers)

- Build repeatable skills or plugins for popular LLM clients to empower your team

- Educate and mentor team members to become more AI-Native

- A builder's mentality: you'd rather ship a working prototype than write a spec about one

- Ability to work cross-functionally and translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders

Preferred requirements:

- Experience with workflow orchestration tools (Agent SDK, n8n, Make, Zapier, or custom Typescript/Python pipelines)

- Prior work at a DTC subscription company or growth-stage startup

- Familiarity with prompt engineering, RAG architectures, or fine-tuning

- Experience building internal tools used by non-technical teams

- Familiarity with marketing platforms and data infrastructure — ideally some combination of Braze, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Snowflake, or equivalent

- Strong enough understanding of growth marketing to ask the right questions and build tools that practitioners actually want to use

Technologies You'll Use

- LLM APIs: OpenAI, Anthropic, and/or open-source models

- CRM & Marketing: Braze, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager

- Data: Snowflake, SQL, Tableau, dbt, Hex

- Orchestration: Typescript, Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, Python, n8n, Make, or similar

- Collaboration: Slack, Notion, Jira, Google Workspace

Benefits

🩺  Health Insurance coverage

🌅 401k Plan

⛱ Unlimited PTO

🥘 A generous amount of CookUnity credits to enjoy our amazing meals, added to your account, monthly

🤖 AI-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster.

jobs.title: Business Analytics Manager
jobs.description:
About CookUnity:

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

The Team

The Business Analytics team is the analytical engine behind CookUnity's growth. We sit at the center of the business to turn behavioral and marketplace data into the decisions that shape acquisition, retention, pricing, and membership. From forecasting and goal-setting to experiment readouts and board-level analysis, this team owns the numbers that leadership relies on to steer the company.

It's a small, high-trust team of analysts who work close to the business, own their stakeholder relationships directly, and hold each other to a high analytical bar through peer review.

The Role

We're looking for a  Business Analytics Manager to lead our Business Analytics team and own the analytical strategy that drives CookUnity's core growth and retention agenda. Reporting to the Head of Data, you'll manage a team of analysts, set priorities against the company's most important questions, and be the analytical partner senior stakeholders come to when they need clarity.

This is a player-coach role. You'll spend part of your time leading — coaching analysts, managing stakeholder demand, and raising the quality of the team's work — and part of your time hands-on in the data on the highest-stakes questions.

You'll be stepping into a well-established function with strong momentum and a talented team, with the mandate to shape its next chapter as CookUnity scales.

Responsibilities

- Lead the Business Analytics team. Manage, coach, and develop a team of analysts. Set clear priorities, unblock the team, and create the space for people to step up and own more.

- Own stakeholder management. Be the primary analytical partner to Growth, Marketing, Product, Finance, and Operations leaders — translating ambiguous business questions into sharp analysis and clear recommendations.

- Design and read out experiments. Partner on the design of A/B tests and holdouts, ensure they're measured rigorously, and translate results into decisions the business can act on — separating causal impact from correlation.

- Own forecasting and goal-setting. Build and maintain the forecasts and goal-sizing (e.g. half-year targets) that leadership plans against.

- Safeguard analytical quality. Run and evolve the team's peer-review process, and sign off on board- and executive-level analysis before it goes out.

- Set the standard. Establish and uphold best practices for how the team works — from analytical rigor and reproducibility to how insights are communicated and prioritized.

- Partner with Data Science & Engineering. Work alongside the broader Data org to ensure the analytics team has the data, tooling, and models it needs to move fast.

Qualifications

- 5+ years in business, growth, or product analytics , with a track record of analysis that changed decisions — not just dashboards.

- 2+ years leading analysts , whether as a manager or a senior IC who has mentored and set direction for a team.

- Advanced SQL and fluency with BI tooling (Looker, Tableau, or similar); comfort with the modern data stack (Snowflake/BigQuery, dbt) is a plus.

- Strong grounding in experimentation and causal thinking — A/B testing, holdouts, incrementality, cohort and funnel analysis.

- Consumer, subscription, or marketplace experience. You understand retention, LTV, acquisition, and pricing dynamics in a consumer business.

- Excellent stakeholder management. You can partner with senior leaders, manage competing demands, and communicate clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Player-coach mindset. You're energized by both developing a team and getting hands-on with the hardest questions yourself.

Benefits

💸 Get paid in USD.

🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want.

⛱ Enjoy 15 days of vacation each year from the start date.

🎄 16 fully paid Argentinean holidays.

Vice President, Growth Marketing

About CookUnity

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 35 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission:  empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About the Growth Organization

The Growth team at CookUnity is the driving force behind our mission to scale the chef-to-you marketplace category and bring our incredible chef-crafted product to millions of new eaters. We are storytellers, strategists, and operators—fueled by data, creativity, and the pursuit of exponential growth.

As we expand our national footprint, the Growth organization plays a key role in shaping how CookUnity acquires, retains, and re-engages customers, blending performance marketing, product innovation, and brand storytelling to redefine what “meal delivery” can be.

About the Role

The Vice President, Growth Marketing will lead the next stage of CookUnity’s growth engine. This executive will own the company’s full-funnel growth strategy, driving customer acquisition, activation, retention, and lifetime value across all digital and offline channels.

You will set the vision, strategy, and operational rigor for paid and organic growth while partnering closely with Brand, Product, Data, and Creative leadership. You will oversee a high-performing team of marketers and channel experts across Paid Social, Search, CRM, CRO, and Emerging Platforms—building scalable, data-informed systems that accelerate new customer growth and deepen engagement across the CookUnity experience.

This role reports directly to the Chief Marketing Officer and plays a critical part in shaping the company’s strategic roadmap, with visibility across executive and board-level discussions.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the Growth Strategy: Own the full-funnel growth vision and roadmap, integrating paid, owned, earned, and product-led growth initiatives to scale efficiently while protecting CAC and maximizing LTV.

- Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and inspire a team of high-performing growth marketers, channel leads, and analysts focused on acquisition, conversion, and retention.

- Channel Excellence: Oversee performance across Meta, Google, TikTok, DSPs, and emerging channels, while expanding into new frontiers such as influencer, affiliate, and partnership-based growth.

- Data & Experimentation: Foster a rigorous culture of testing, measurement, and optimization—leveraging analytics, attribution, and cohort insights to drive decisions.

- Product-Led Growth: Partner with Product and Tech to identify and execute high-impact growth loops, cross-sell, upsell, and referral initiatives across the CookUnity ecosystem.

- Brand x Growth Integration: Collaborate with Creative and Brand to develop compelling storytelling and performance-driven creative that elevates CookUnity’s chef-led value proposition.

- Forecasting & Performance Management: Own growth forecasting, budget allocation, and reporting across all digital and offline performance channels.

- Thought Leadership: Stay ahead of emerging trends, technologies, and platforms (AI, personalization, creator economy, etc.)—ensuring CookUnity remains at the forefront of modern marketing innovation.

Qualifications

- 12+ years of experience in growth marketing, digital acquisition, and lifecycle management within fast-paced, high-growth DTC or marketplace environments.

- Proven success leading large-scale customer acquisition and retention programs across multiple channels.

- Deep understanding of marketing analytics, attribution, cohort analysis, and performance forecasting.

- Exceptional leadership experience building and managing teams across media, data, creative, and product functions.

- Strong background in experimentation frameworks, conversion rate optimization, and funnel diagnostics.

- Demonstrated success partnering with senior executives to shape company strategy and growth objectives.

- Experience managing large marketing budgets with an ROI-driven, analytical mindset.

- Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.

Personal Characteristics

- Visionary leader with entrepreneurial energy, strategic clarity, and a bias toward action.

- Balances creativity and analytical rigor—equally fluent in data dashboards and storytelling decks.

- Highly collaborative and capable of influencing across multiple teams and stakeholders.

- Deep empathy for the customer and passion for building a category-defining brand.

- Thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, combining big-picture thinking with tactical execution.

- Strong communicator who inspires teams, energizes partners, and can represent CookUnity externally as a growth thought leader.

A quick note for all candidates
We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data)  stay safe while applying to CookUnity.  We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief  “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us:

- Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:  careers.cookunity.com

- Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official  LinkedIn Company Page .

- We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in  @cookunity.com  and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS.

- We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away.

If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.
